title: What's live, and what's next.
intro: Canopy ships in small, separate updates. The contracts can't be upgraded, so each update adds an adapter, new alarms or a new deployment, and positions armed today keep working.

items.title: Auto-exit on Robinhood Chain
items.body: Arm ERC-4626 vault positions, such as Morpho's USDG vaults, with the alarms you choose.

items.title: Free wallet check and risk cards
items.body: Paste any address to see its vault positions and plain-words risk facts. No connection needed.

items.title: Free Telegram alerts
items.body: Follow any vault in @CanopyAlerts_Bot and hear when an alarm fires.

items.title: Five alarm presets and 2-of-3 watchers
items.body: Vault loss, pause, exploit confirmed, and drain or curator change with confirmation.

items.title: Phone wallets
items.body: Connect a phone wallet by QR code through WalletConnect.

items.title: Verified source
items.body: Every contract verified on Blockscout and Sourcify with an exact match.

items.title: Base
items.body: Auto-exit for Base's USDC vaults, with the same rules and one app for both chains.

items.title: Uniswap v3 LP exits
items.body: Arm a liquidity position and get both tokens and your unclaimed fees back in your wallet when an alarm fires.

items.title: Alerts in the app
items.body: Phone and browser notifications from the installed app, for anyone who doesn't use Telegram. Still no email and no account.

items.title: Run your own keeper
items.body: The open-source keeper runs on its own, so exits never depend on Canopy staying online.

items.title: More vaults, on request
items.body: Every Robinhood Chain vault that passes the safety checks, and a way to ask for the one you use.

items.title: Exit to stablecoin
items.body: For vaults that pay out ETH or another non-stable asset, choose to get USDC or USDG instead, with oracle-checked limits and a 1% cap when a keeper runs it.

items.title: Live exit log
items.body: A public page of every exit: what fired, how fast it ran and the transaction.

items.title: Exit receipts
items.body: A shareable record after each exit with what fired, how fast and what came back.

items.title: Several wallets, one view
items.body: Follow and arm positions across all your wallets from one screen.

items.title: Outside watchers and challenges
items.body: Independent watchers beyond Canopy's own, and a way to challenge a wrong watcher alarm on-chain.

items.title: Uniswap v4 LP exits
items.body: The same exit for v4 positions.

items.title: Your own alarm levels
items.body: Set your own loss threshold or window instead of a preset.

items.title: Robinhood Earn wallets
items.body: Auto-exit for positions held in the Robinhood app, if those wallets can sign.

items.title: Aave positions
items.body: Exits for lending positions beyond ERC-4626 vaults.

items.title: EIP-7702 wallets
items.body: Arming from wallets that delegate to smart-account code.

items.title: Canopy Index
items.body: A public, live view of vault risk across chains.
